schema.vertexLabel('location').ifNotExists().partitionBy('location_id', Uuid).property('geo_point', Point).property('name', Varchar).create()
schema.vertexLabel('person').ifNotExists().partitionBy('person_id', Uuid).property('age', Int).property('name', Varchar).property('badge', mapOf(Varchar, Date)).property('nickname', setOf(Varchar)).create()
schema.vertexLabel('recipe').ifNotExists().partitionBy('recipe_id', Uuid).property('cuisine', Varchar).property('instructions', Varchar).property('name', Varchar).property('tags', setOf(Varchar)).create()
schema.edgeLabel('created').ifNotExists().from('person').to('recipe').partitionBy(OUT, 'person_id', 'person_person_id').clusterBy(IN, 'recipe_id', 'recipe_recipe_id', Asc).property('created_on', Date).create()
schema.edgeLabel('knows').ifNotExists().from('person').to('person').partitionBy(OUT, 'person_id', 'out_person_id').clusterBy(IN, 'person_id', 'in_person_id', Asc).property('since', Date).create()
schema.edgeLabel('located_at').ifNotExists().from('person').to('location').partitionBy(OUT, 'person_id', 'person_person_id').clusterBy(IN, 'location_id', 'location_location_id', Asc).create()
schema.vertexLabel('location').searchIndex().ifNotExists().by('location_id').by('geo_point').create()
schema.vertexLabel('person').materializedView('person_by_name').ifNotExists().partitionBy('name').clusterBy('person_id', Asc).create()
schema.vertexLabel('recipe').searchIndex().ifNotExists().by('recipe_id').by('cuisine').asString().by('instructions').asText().create()
schema.edgeLabel('knows').from('person').to('person').materializedView('knows_by_since').ifNotExists().partitionBy(OUT, 'person_id').clusterBy('since', Asc).clusterBy(IN, 'person_id', Asc).create()
